rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=8, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, pretrain_epochs=30, pretrain_lr=0.001, pretrain_patience=5, itnet_k=3, unet_c=24, residual_learning=False, rationale=iter-4: KNOB=pretrain_epochs 8->30 (~4x; KEEP residual_learning=False from iter-3, do NOT revert). iter-3 fixed the double-residual wiring bug (residual_learning True->False) and itnet_v2 jumped 0.3429->0.5373 (val_psnr 16.3 dB) -- the denoiser is now CORRECTLY wired (pretrain target=truth, eval path=denoiser(x) directly, v1 recipe) but UNDER-TRAINED: siblings itnet(v1)=0.9729 and itnet_v3=0.9683 sit ~0.97 while v2 is at 0.54 with only 8 pretrain epochs. The 8-epoch budget was set when the broken wiring pinned output near FBP-init and more epochs couldn't help; now that the U-Net can actually fit FBP->truth, 8 epochs is far too few. HYPOTHESIS: ~4x more pretrain epochs (8->30) lets the residual denoiser fit the FBP->truth residual and the k=3 DC step refine it, approaching the sibling ~0.97 plateau. Wall guard: 30 epochs ~= 4x iter-3's ~125s ~= 500s (<15 min); val_n dropped 20->8 to cut the val pass and keep margin.
